Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    varIsAdmin,
    Navigate(Screen_Settings, ScreenTransition.Fade),
    Notify("Settings are for admins only", NotificationType.Error)
)
"Review submitted weeks and open a day for edits"

Refresh('Hours Tracking (Hours)');
Set(
    varWeeklyLoadFrom,
    If(
        !IsBlank(DatePicker_WeeklyFrom.SelectedDate) && !IsBlank(DatePicker_WeeklyTo.SelectedDate),
        DateAdd(DatePicker_WeeklyFrom.SelectedDate, -6, "Days"),
        If(
            !IsBlank(varWeeklyEmployeeEmail),
            varAppStartDate,
            DateAdd(Today(), -56, "Days")
        )
    )
);
Set(
    varWeeklyLoadTo,
    If(
        !IsBlank(DatePicker_WeeklyFrom.SelectedDate) && !IsBlank(DatePicker_WeeklyTo.SelectedDate),
        DateAdd(DatePicker_WeeklyTo.SelectedDate, 6, "Days"),
        DateAdd(Today(), 21, "Days")
    )
);
Clear(colRawHours);
If(
    !IsBlank(varWeeklyEmployeeEmail),
    If(
        varIsSuperAdmin,
        Collect(
            colRawHours,
            Filter(
                'Hours Tracking (Hours)',
                Employee = varWeeklyEmployeeEmail &&
                ApprovalStatus_1 = "Pending" &&
                Date >= varWeeklyLoadFrom &&
                Date <= varWeeklyLoadTo
            )
        );
        Collect(
            colRawHours,
            Filter(
                'Hours Tracking (Hours)',
                Employee = varWeeklyEmployeeEmail &&
                ApprovalStatus_1 = "Approved" &&
                Date >= varWeeklyLoadFrom &&
                Date <= varWeeklyLoadTo
            )
        );
        Collect(
            colRawHours,
            Filter(
                'Hours Tracking (Hours)',
                Employee = varWeeklyEmployeeEmail &&
                ApprovalStatus_1 = "Rejected" &&
                Date >= varWeeklyLoadFrom &&
                Date <= varWeeklyLoadTo
            )
        ),
        Collect(
            colRawHours,
            Filter(
                'Hours Tracking (Hours)',
                Employee = varWeeklyEmployeeEmail &&
                ApproverID_1 = User().Email &&
                ApprovalStatus_1 = "Pending" &&
                Date >= varWeeklyLoadFrom &&
                Date <= varWeeklyLoadTo
            )
        );
        Collect(
            colRawHours,
            Filter(
                'Hours Tracking (Hours)',
                Employee = varWeeklyEmployeeEmail &&
                ApproverID_1 = User().Email &&
                ApprovalStatus_1 = "Approved" &&
                Date >= varWeeklyLoadFrom &&
                Date <= varWeeklyLoadTo
            )
        );
        Collect(
            colRawHours,
            Filter(
                'Hours Tracking (Hours)',
                Employee = varWeeklyEmployeeEmail &&
                ApproverID_1 = User().Email &&
                ApprovalStatus_1 = "Rejected" &&
                Date >= varWeeklyLoadFrom &&
                Date <= varWeeklyLoadTo
            )
        )
    ),
    If(
        varIsSuperAdmin,
        Collect(
            colRawHours,
            Filter(
                'Hours Tracking (Hours)',
                ApprovalStatus_1 = "Pending" &&
                Date >= varWeeklyLoadFrom &&
                Date <= varWeeklyLoadTo
            )
        );
        Collect(
            colRawHours,
            Filter(
                'Hours Tracking (Hours)',
                ApprovalStatus_1 = "Approved" &&
                Date >= varWeeklyLoadFrom &&
                Date <= varWeeklyLoadTo
            )
        );
        Collect(
            colRawHours,
            Filter(
                'Hours Tracking (Hours)',
                ApprovalStatus_1 = "Rejected" &&
                Date >= varWeeklyLoadFrom &&
                Date <= varWeeklyLoadTo
            )
        ),
        Collect(
            colRawHours,
            Filter(
                'Hours Tracking (Hours)',
                ApproverID_1 = User().Email &&
                ApprovalStatus_1 = "Pending" &&
                Date >= varWeeklyLoadFrom &&
                Date <= varWeeklyLoadTo
            )
        );
        Collect(
            colRawHours,
            Filter(
                'Hours Tracking (Hours)',
                ApproverID_1 = User().Email &&
                ApprovalStatus_1 = "Approved" &&
                Date >= varWeeklyLoadFrom &&
                Date <= varWeeklyLoadTo
            )
        );
        Collect(
            colRawHours,
            Filter(
                'Hours Tracking (Hours)',
                ApproverID_1 = User().Email &&
                ApprovalStatus_1 = "Rejected" &&
                Date >= varWeeklyLoadFrom &&
                Date <= varWeeklyLoadTo
            )
        )
    )
);
ClearCollect(
    colAllPendingHours,
    ForAll(
        colRawHours,
        {
            ID: ThisRecord.ID,
            Employee: ThisRecord.Employee,
            Employee_Name: ThisRecord.Employee_Name,
            Date: ThisRecord.Date,
            Standard_time: ThisRecord.Standard_time,
            ApprovalStatus_1: ThisRecord.ApprovalStatus_1,
            Cost_code: ThisRecord.Cost_code,
            Comments: ThisRecord.Comments,
            ApproverID_1: ThisRecord.ApproverID_1
        }
    )
);
ClearCollect(
    colWeeklySummary,
    GroupBy(
        AddColumns(
            colAllPendingHours,
            WeekStart,
            DateAdd(Date, -(Weekday(Date, StartOfWeek.Monday) - 1), "Days")
        ),
        Employee_Name,
        Employee,
        WeekStart,
        WeekRecords
    )
);
ClearCollect(
    colWeeklySummaryDisplay,
    AddColumns(
        colWeeklySummary,
        WeekEnd,
        DateAdd(WeekStart, 6, "Days"),
        TotalStandard,
        Sum(WeekRecords, Standard_time),
        TotalDays,
        CountRows(WeekRecords),
        WeekStatus,
        If(
            CountIf(WeekRecords, ApprovalStatus_1 = "Rejected") = CountRows(WeekRecords),
            "Rejected",
            If(
                CountIf(WeekRecords, ApprovalStatus_1 = "Approved") = CountRows(WeekRecords),
                "Approved",
                If(
                    CountIf(WeekRecords, ApprovalStatus_1 = "Pending") > 0,
                    "Pending",
                    "Mixed"
                )
            )
        )
    )
)
"Approve every pending timesheet for this filter"

SortByColumns(
    Filter(
        colWeeklySummaryDisplay,
        (
            varShowAllWeeks ||
            WeekStatus = "Pending" ||
            WeekStatus = "Rejected"
        ) &&
        (
            IsBlank(varWeeklyEmployeeEmail) ||
            Lower(Employee) = varWeeklyEmployeeEmail
        ) &&
        (
            IsBlank(DatePicker_WeeklyFrom.SelectedDate) ||
            IsBlank(DatePicker_WeeklyTo.SelectedDate) ||
            (WeekStart <= DatePicker_WeeklyTo.SelectedDate && WeekEnd >= DatePicker_WeeklyFrom.SelectedDate)
        )
    ),
    varWeeklySortColumn,
    If(varWeeklySortAscending, SortOrder.Ascending, SortOrder.Descending)
)
If(ThisItem.WeekStatus = "Approved", RGBA(108, 212, 136, 1), ThisItem.WeekStatus = "Rejected", RGBA(252, 124, 124, 1), ThisItem.WeekStatus = "Pending", RGBA(252, 250, 124, 1), RGBA(230, 230, 230, 1))
"You have not set a From and To date range. This will approve every pending entry matching the current employee filter. Do you want to continue?"
